items.lede: The move puts Edits in more direct competition with ByteDance's CapCut, the video-editing app Meta sought to challenge when it launched Edits last year.
items.title: Instagram brings Edits to desktop to take on CapCut

items.lede: Meta's CapCut competitor already has more than 50 million users.
items.title: Instagram's Edits is now on desktop as a Mac app
